responsibility: This file implements GCC’s core checking-build selftest framework. It provides pass/fail accounting and formatted failure reporting, string assertion helpers, temporary-file and temporary-source-file utilities, deterministic quote handling for locale-independent tests, file-reading and selftest-file location helpers, the test_runner summary printer, and a small set of selftests for the framework and selected libiberty helpers. Its responsibility is the generic test harness and utility layer used by embedded GCC unit tests.
same_name_distinction: Provides the runtime implementation of GCC's generic selftest framework—pass/fail reporting, string assertions, temporary-file utilities, file loading, and test-runner summary output—while selftest.h defines the public macros, helper class declarations, and API surface used by tests throughout gcc/.
